summary.text: Kat McGhee is a Democratic state representative from Hillsborough 35 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election; she assumed her current seat in December 2022.
She works in information technology and has served on the Science, Technology and Energy Committee.

paragraphs.text: Kat McGhee earned an M.Ed. in psychology from Cambridge College.
Her career experience includes working as a software program manager and as a consultant to the chief information officer of John Hancock Financial Services.
Ballotpedia lists McGhee's tenure in the New Hampshire House as beginning in 2018, and she assumed her current seat representing Hillsborough 35 on December 7, 2022.
She was assigned to the Science, Technology and Energy Committee in 2019-2020, 2021-2022 and 2023-2024.
